answer: The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in garden, expire in terrace, and basalt lists each expiry. Anyone running 11 aliases therefore needs 92 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 994 identities would post 4167 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
